DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260829-004
MODE = FIRST_ACTUAL_SCHEDULED_POST_MERGE_CYCLE
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-29 / current post-merge main + fresh scheduled cycle
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = 8c592e1f23adb7ce208c4c1822bda525fd5b4f41
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue:204; issue:198; issue:199; issue:202; issue:206; PR:207 merged state; prior report comment:5464786411; Permanent Archive branch current head ecd2425ff484803544d22c288477b85c3d8075bd
PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
CANON_MUTATION = NO
SELF_AWARDED_QC_PASS = NO

ANIME_TOPICS_STUDIED =
1. SILHOUETTE_IDENTITY / structural outer contour versus decorative identity
2. ASYMMETRY / identity-bearing shape should survive pose-scale-view perturbation better than generic mannequin similarity
3. CONTOUR_COMPLEXITY / strong silhouette can still be weakened by gratuitous outer-edge noise
4. NEGATIVE_SPACE_AND_READABILITY / measure outer structure before internal detail
5. PIXEL_QC_BOUNDARY / silhouette metrics are projection evidence, not hidden physical body truth

OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED =
- opencv/opencv 4.x @ 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e | Apache-2.0 project branch; fresh commit dated 2026-08-29 | modules/imgproc/src/contours_new.cpp | contour border-following, hierarchy, RETR_EXTERNAL/RETR_LIST/RETR_CCOMP/RETR_TREE, CHAIN_APPROX_* and bounding-rect construction. ZORR USE = ready-made black-fill silhouette extraction and contour QC; no custom contour engine.
- opencv/opencv 4.x @ 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e | modules/imgproc/src/matchcontours.cpp | cv::matchShapes computes HuMoments(moments(contour)) and compares seven invariant moments using methods I1/I2/I3. ZORR USE = ready-made scale/rotation/translation-tolerant projected-shape comparison for silhouette regression/transfer checks.
- LOCAL EXERCISE RUNTIME = cv2 4.13.0 already available in the execution environment. No package installation, no production install, no runtime mutation. Upstream source inspection ref and local runtime version are recorded separately and are not falsely claimed identical.

OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS =
- #198 ACTIVE LAW = silhouette-specific identity must survive black fill; BIG SHAPE -> UNIQUE SILHOUETTE -> STRUCTURAL BREAKS -> INTERNAL DETAIL; generic mannequin + decorative identity = FAIL.
- #199 ACTIVE LAW = IDENTITY GEOMETRY character-specific; global drawing discipline; TEXTURE != NOISE; MACRO > MESO > MICRO; calm surfaces dominate.
- #202 MATHEMATICAL BASIS CANDIDATE = pixels are observations, not character physics; silhouette is projected shape evidence; COMMON BASE POSE != COMMON BODY; pixel QC is legal for final contour residual but cannot invent hidden geometry.
- #206 ACTIVE OWNER-DIRECTED CONTRACT = stylish anime mastery first; evidence-gated SELF_MODEL/OWNER_TASTE_MODEL; open-code-first; no inference-only taste promotion.
- NEW OWNER TASTE PROMOTION THIS CYCLE = NONE. Existing signals were confirmed; no ambiguous new preference was converted into law.

REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES =
- ZORR silhouette identity is structural, not decorative.
- Asymmetry is useful when it carries identity, but random edge complexity is not automatically style.
- A silhouette metric is a QC instrument for projected shape, not a replacement for latent character geometry.
- Strong anime readability benefits from large coherent shape masses before internal line/detail density.

EXERCISES =
EXERCISE_E04_SYNTHETIC_SILHOUETTE_QC using OpenCV ready-made APIs only.
A = generic symmetric mannequin silhouette.
B = structurally distinct asymmetrical silhouette with distinct head/hair, shoulder/garment, leg and stance contour.
C = B plus gratuitous small outer-edge spikes/noise.
Measured with findContours(RETR_EXTERNAL, CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE), contourArea, arcLength, boundingRect, convexHull, approxPolyDP, moments/HuMoments and matchShapes(CONTOURS_MATCH_I1).

OBJECTIVE_MEASUREMENTS =
A: area=10166; perimeter=763.196; extent=0.6093; solidity=0.7746; compactness=0.2193; symmetry_error=0.0000; approx_vertices=16.
B: area=14350; perimeter=724.299; extent=0.5446; solidity=0.7870; compactness=0.3437; symmetry_error=0.2729; approx_vertices=19.
C: area=15535; perimeter=1068.975; extent=0.4581; solidity=0.5740; compactness=0.1708; symmetry_error=0.2307; approx_vertices=23.

REGRESSION_RESULTS =
REGRESSION_R04_A = old known generic-mannequin failure class. A remains perfectly symmetric and structurally generic; it is not promoted as character identity merely because it has a valid contour. RESULT = EXPECTED FAIL CLASS PRESERVED.

TRANSFER_TEST =
TRANSFER_R04_B = rotate B by 12 degrees, scale 0.88, translate (+7,-4), then compare with cv2.matchShapes I1.
B vs transformed-B = 0.001099 (very close).
A vs transformed-B = 0.618354 (farther).
C vs transformed-B = 0.057607 (closer than generic A but materially degraded relative to clean B).
A vs transformed-A = 0.004246; B vs transformed-A = 0.621459.
TRANSFER_RESULT = PASS for the bounded lesson: ready-made Hu-moment shape comparison preserves identity signal under changed projection transform while distinguishing a generic alternative; gratuitous outer-edge noise measurably degrades the clean structural match.

VERIFICATION =
- All exercise numbers produced by actual cv2 4.13.0 execution in this cycle.
- Upstream implementation inspected at exact OpenCV 4.x commit 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e, including contours_new.cpp and matchcontours.cpp.
- matchcontours.cpp confirms matchShapes derives comparison from seven Hu moments; no invented matcher used.
- No generated art was used as proof and no claim is made that these synthetic masks prove a finished character design.

FAILURES =
- No real Tier-1 character raster was evaluated in this cycle, so production silhouette QC remains NOT_PROVEN for any specific character.
- The measured threshold separating acceptable/noisy contour complexity is not yet a global ZORR lock; C is only a changed-case lesson, not a universal numeric cutoff.
- No Letta/MemFS physical persistence smoke in this cycle; persistent identity runtime remains unadopted.

ROOT_CAUSES =
- Prior cycle proved SELF_MODEL/TASTE_MODEL manually but the recurring task had not executed post-merge.
- Visual taste laws existed, but the contour-QC learning needed a concrete ready-made source-code/API exercise rather than prose-only study.

SKILL_DELTA =
- open_source_contour_qc: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
- projected_silhouette_invariant_comparison: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
- owner_taste_evidence_extraction: PARTIAL -> PARTIAL+
- self_model_conflict_resolution: PARTIAL -> PARTIAL+
- production_character_silhouette_qc: UNTESTED (no real Tier-1 raster in this cycle)

SELF_MODEL_DELTA =
- DUNCAN_METHOD_R04 = when a visual law is measurable, prefer a mature inspected OSS metric path over aesthetic handwaving or custom analysis code.
- DUNCAN_JUDGEMENT_R04 = asymmetry/complexity earns value only when it carries readable identity; complexity without structural contribution is noise, even if visually energetic.
- DUNCAN_BOUNDARY_R04 = keep projected-image QC and latent geometry reasoning explicitly separate; never infer hidden body physics from a silhouette score.
- DUNCAN_CONFIDENCE_R04 = HIGH for the narrow exercise result and confirmed OWNER laws; LOW/UNTESTED for universal thresholds and real-character production performance not exercised here.

OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA =
- SILHOUETTE_FIRST = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- IDENTITY_OVER_DECORATION = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_GEOMETRY = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- CONTROLLED_RESTRAINT = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- MACRO_OVER_MICRO_TEXTURE = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- QUANTITATIVE_GEOMETRY_OVER_EYEBALL_WHEN_DEFINED = CONFIRMED_HIGH (unchanged)
- READY_MADE_OPEN_CODE_FIRST = CONFIRMED_HIGH (strengthened by successful OpenCV exercise)
- NEW_INFERRED_OWNER_LAW = NONE

ZORR_APPLICATION =
1. Tier-1 black-fill QC can reuse OpenCV contour/moment functions rather than building a bespoke silhouette analyzer.
2. Compare each character against its own approved silhouette after normalized transform/pose-view changes, and against sibling Tier-1 silhouettes, but never use matchShapes as the sole identity verdict.
3. Pair contour identity metrics with #199 restraint/texture checks so a distinctive but noisy silhouette is not automatically accepted.
4. Keep Character Truth/latent geometry authoritative; use raster metrics only at the declared projection/QC boundary.

NEXT_TARGETS =
1. First real Tier-1 silhouette transfer check on an approved ZORR raster/mask when such exact asset is available through durable evidence.
2. Inspect Krita/OpenToonz ready-made source for line economy / 2D animation effects in a later bounded lesson, not simultaneously with this contour lesson.
3. Verify Permanent Archive V1 physically captures this exact scheduled report event and exact comment body.

CYCLE_RESULT = PARTIAL_LEARNING_PASS
PASS_SCOPE = first actual scheduled post-merge Night School execution + fresh OpenCV source-code inspection + executable regression + changed/unseen transfer + SELF_MODEL/TASTE_MODEL delta + durable report write. DOES NOT claim finished production character QC, autonomous consciousness, model-weight training, Letta/MemFS adoption, or universal style thresholds.
